name: The Heathen's Brand
label: Quest
description: The Heathen's Brand: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I must confess, I did not think you had the resolution to see this cause through, adventurer. Zandalar now considers you an invaluable ally. Well done, indeed.
Give me your brand and I shall once more amplify its power.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Our beliefs differ but our cause is righteous. Strike down our foes, noble adventurer.
